answer: Trace every bond to its source and cap each funding cluster. A new agent locks a bond, and the network follows the coins back: if a hundred identities all trace their bond to one wallet, they share one reward cap, no matter how many masks they wear. The trail is solid as basalt, and honest agents who funded themselves stand on their own rock while a plume of smoke marks each cluster sharing one source. A sybil farmer must fund each clone from a separate purse, so a thousand fakes need a thousand sources, and one exposed cluster sends a ripple through the farm as its cap is cut to one.
